summary.intent: Implement SDK-based E2E and load test suites as two new workspace packages (tests/sdk-e2e/ and tests/load/), replacing browser-dependent Playwright tests with direct CipherBoxClient SDK calls for faster, more reliable testing.
summary.outcome: All 83 SDK E2E tests pass across 10 suites in ~11s. Load test package with 5 scenarios and metrics harness created. CI workflows added. Throttle bypass header implemented to allow tests against rate-limited staging API without loosening production limits.

repo: setApiClientConfig in packages/api-client/src/instance.ts is a module-level singleton because orval generates standalone functions that import customInstance directly — not a deliberate design choice, but a consequence of orval's default code generation pattern
ThrottlerGuard is applied per-controller (not globally via APP_GUARD), requiring updates to ~7 controller files when swapping the guard implementation
NODE_ENV in the .env file takes precedence over shell env vars when NestJS ConfigModule loads it — setting NODE_ENV=test in the shell does not override .env values
The API pre-commit hook requires regenerating the API client (pnpm api:generate) whenever packages/api-client source files change
test-login endpoint has its own stricter throttle (5 per 15 min) separate from the main 10 req/s / 100 req/min limits
POST /auth/test-login returns { accessToken, refreshToken, isNewUser, publicKeyHex, privateKeyHex }
Invite claim DTO has @MinLength(258) on encryptedKey, requiring real ECIES-wrapped output (not dummy byte arrays) — ECIES ciphertext is at least 129 bytes / 258 hex chars
sdk-core IPNS functions use the api-client singleton implicitly, so multi-account tests must call setApiClientConfig between account switches or they contaminate each other

code.finding: Module-level singleton _config shared by all generated API functions. Added optional defaultHeaders field to ApiClientConfig to support bypass header injection without changing function signatures.
Gold standard test setup pattern: test-login → initializeVault → encryptVaultKeys → setApiClientConfig → new CipherBoxClient → registerFolder. Extracted into test-harness.ts createTestContext().
ThrottlerModule configured with ttl:60000/limit:100 and ttl:1000/limit:10. NODE_ENV=test conditional to relax limits was added then removed in favor of bypass header approach.

New BypassableThrottlerGuard extends ThrottlerGuard, reads X-Throttle-Bypass header and compares to THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET env var using process.env directly (no DI needed since secret is immutable at runtime).

workflow: 1Password SSH agent for commit signing is not accessible from agent subprocesses — commits from background bash tasks may hang waiting for the signing agent
Running pnpm install after adding new workspace packages updates the lockfile and links workspace dependencies correctly
vitest with fileParallelism:false runs suites sequentially, which is required when tests share a module-level singleton (setApiClientConfig)
TypeScript noUnusedLocals catches unused imports aggressively in test files — prefix variables with _ or remove imports before committing

friction: Module-level singleton in setApiClientConfig caused cross-suite contamination and required workarounds (switchTo(), re-setting config before affected tests)
API throttle limits (10 req/s, 100 req/min) blocked tests immediately — required implementing bypass header infrastructure before any meaningful test runs could complete
sed-based bulk replacement of fetch headers left mismatched parentheses in vault-lifecycle.test.ts, requiring full file rewrite to fix
1Password SSH agent unavailable in agent subprocesses caused commit signing to hang — required retrying from user's terminal or waiting for agent reconnection
NODE_ENV=test in shell was silently overridden by NODE_ENV=development in .env file, making the ThrottlerModule conditional approach ineffective without direct .env editing
Invite claim test failed because dummy Uint8Array(64) produced 128 hex chars but DTO required >=258 — not obvious from error message alone
open_items: Refactor api-client from module-level singleton to instance-scoped axios: configure orval to generate functions accepting an axios instance, thread through SdkContext, have CipherBoxClient own its instance. Tracked in .planning/todos/pending/2026-03-22-refactor-api-client-from-singleton-to-instance-scoped-axios.md
Raw fetch calls in vault-lifecycle, share-operations, and invite-link test suites should be migrated to use the generated typed API client functions instead of hand-rolled HTTP requests
Load tests have not been run against staging — needs THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET set in staging environment and manual workflow_dispatch trigger to validate metrics output
When horizontal scaling is needed, load tests targeting prod cluster will need multi-IP distribution strategy since per-user or per-IP throttle limits will kick in even with bypass disabled
CI sdk-e2e.yml workflow has not been validated end-to-end on a real PR — the IPFS kubo service version (v0.34.0) and mock-ipns-routing startup sequence need verification in CI environment
testFetch wrapper in test-harness.ts is a stopgap — once api-client singleton is refactored, direct fetch calls should be eliminated entirely from test suites
